# ARENOVA — Comprehensive Technical & Architectural Documentation

## Organization Identity
- Brand Name: ARENOVA
- Full Legal / Operating Name: ARENOVA Systems Architecture & AI Automation
- Website: https://arenova.in
- Parent Entity for: Arenova Frontdesk, Arova, Outreacher
- Primary Contact: avi@arenova.in
- Headquarters Domain: arenova.in

## Core Mission & Architecture
Arenova bridges the chasm between paid media spend, customer inquiry intake, and closed revenue. By pairing precision performance marketing (Meta Ads and Google Ads) with 24/7 AI front desk automation and autonomous backend workflows, businesses capture and qualify inbound prospects within 15 seconds.

## Primary Service Disciplines

### 1. AI Front Desk Agents
- Objective: Capture 100% of inbound enquiries 24/7 across multiple communication channels.
- Inbound Channels: Voice telephony, WhatsApp Business API, SMS, and Web Chat widgets.
- Core Mechanisms:
  - Intent extraction and natural language triage under 15 seconds.
  - Strict guardrails trained strictly on company-provided service catalogs, FAQs, and pricing matrices (zero hallucination).
  - Multi-tier qualification based on territory, budget, urgency, and service fit.
  - Automated calendar synchronization with direct booking holds into Calendly, Acuity, Cliniko, or Dentrix.
  - Seamless escalation triggers to on-call human staff when urgent or out-of-scope criteria are detected.

### 2. Workflow Automation & System Orchestration
- Objective: Eliminate manual clerical busywork and data silos between disjointed SaaS tools.
- Supported Integrations: HubSpot, Salesforce, Make.com, Zapier Enterprise, PostgreSQL, Stripe, QuickBooks, Xero.
- Core Capabilities:
  - Automated CRM contact creation and qualification score tagging.
  - Real-time contract and invoice generation upon client sign-off.
  - Two-way database synchronization preventing clerical drift.
  - Instant internal team alerts via Slack, Microsoft Teams, or SMS.

### 3. Custom AI Agents
- Objective: Domain-specific autonomous workers trained on proprietary enterprise knowledge.
- Capabilities:
  - Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) using vector embeddings grounded in verified company documents.
  - Automated proposal drafting, RFP response compilation, and executive brief generation.
  - Human-in-the-loop validation checkpoints for sensitive commercial workflows.

### 4. Performance Marketing & Revenue Engines
- Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram): Visual disruption, cinematic storytelling, and paid social acquisition funnels designed to generate qualified appointments.
- Google Ads (Search & Performance Max): High-intent demand capture, search query domination, and negative keyword moats that cut wasted budget by an average of 38%.
- Pipeline Acceleration: Sub-15-second lead follow-up automation converting ad clicks into qualified calendar bookings before prospect intent decays.

### 5. Conversion-Engineered Web Experiences
- High-performance, cinematic digital flagships engineered for conversion rate optimization (CRO) and enterprise credibility.
- Optimized for Core Web Vitals (sub-2.5s LCP, sub-200ms INP, zero CLS).

## Product Ecosystem Relationships

Arenova operates as the parent engineering agency and technology incubator for three specialized platforms:

1. **Arenova Frontdesk** (`https://frontdesk.arenova.in`):
   - Vertical: Healthcare, clinics, aesthetic medicine, and local service practices.
   - Purpose: Automated WhatsApp AI receptionist handling patient inquiries, triage, and appointment booking.
   - Parent Brand: Arenova.

2. **Arova** (`https://arova.arenova.in`):
   - Vertical: B2B sales teams, agencies, and enterprise growth operators.
   - Purpose: B2B lead intelligence and qualified business leads discovery platform.
   - Parent Brand: Arenova.

3. **Outreacher** (`https://outreacher.arenova.in`):
   - Vertical: B2B outbound sales and pipeline acceleration.
   - Purpose: Multi-stage email outreach and sales workflow automation platform.
   - Parent Brand: Arenova.
